items.text: ADSL pilots replace dial-up; “always-on” hits homes.
ADSL coverage expands island-wide; more ISPs explore early fibre pilots.
Cable broadband ramps; home Wi-Fi (802.11b/g) appears across HDBs.
3G mobile data launches; tethering and early mobile portals take off.
Wi-Fi routers bundled with home broadband—wireless becomes default at home.
Wireless@SG launches—free public Wi-Fi at libraries, malls, MRT nodes.
Wireless@SG expands coverage/speeds; campuses and cafes go wall-to-wall Wi-Fi.

items.fact: Open-access model splits passive infra from retail—fair competition + universal fibre.

items.text: First neighbourhoods light up on fibre; retail trials roll out broadly.
items.fact: Fibre pulls into older estates and new BTOs.

items.text: Retail fibre plans launch at scale; gigabit-class becomes affordable.
NGNBN goes mainstream; peering and ISP competition heat up.
Smart Nation platforms harden—sensors, data exchange, digital ID rails.
5G rollout begins; low-latency mobile for real-time apps.
items.fact: NSA → SA migration starts; early edge trials.

items.text: 5G SA matures; MEC + Wi-Fi 6/6E boost last-mile capacity.
